comment.comment: A whole-line or trailing comment. A '#' inside a quoted value is handled by #string and never reaches here.
comment.name: comment.line.number-sign.paradox

entry.comment: A loc key, the ':' separator, and an optional version number directly after the colon (KEY:0). No leading whitespace is required.

string.comment: Paradox loc strings run to the LAST unescaped quote on the line, so an embedded '"' is data, not a terminator. The end anchor only closes at a quote followed by optional whitespace and an optional trailing comment.
string.name: string.quoted.double.paradox

loc-reference.comment: A reference to another loc key, e.g. $OTHER_KEY$.
loc-reference.name: variable.parameter.paradox

loc-icon.comment: An inline icon tag, e.g. £gold or £army_experience£ .
loc-icon.name: keyword.other.icon.paradox
